record.question: Which European power first established settlements in India?
record.explanation: Answer B: Portuguese. The Portuguese established the earliest European trading footholds among the listed powers. Reference: https://www.britannica.com/place/India/European-settlement. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
